description: Players ranked by statistics, up to 5 boards, ties sharing a place. Presets: playtime (hours), diamonds, advancements, mobs, travel (km), deaths, blocks, fish, damage (hearts), netherite, experience, tamed. Or any statistic as `category:key`, such as `mined:diamond_ore` or `killed:*`. Without statistics, the presets and everyone's totals: hours, blocks mined, mobs killed, deaths, advancements, world day.
name: get_leaderboard
